item.tib: gsang sngags las kyi kha tshar rba drag chu lha'i bskul pa
item.coloph: gsang sngags thams cad kyi kha tshar/ 'bod rbad bsad pa'i mdel thung / phrin las myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul/ 'byung ba dbang 'dus kyi rgyal po/ bya sla khyer bde 'dod pa kun 'byung gi nor bu zhes bya ba/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pas gsang sngags yongs kyi kha tshar du mdzad nas brgyud pa'o//
